protocol: All validation datasets were unscored under harness-validation-plan.json before the fixed five-round cohort. No scored-cohort runs were discarded. Original failed runs remain on the host.

validation.outcome: Stopped during harness setup before a scored suite; inherited environment appeared in a harness log. Private log chmod600; omitted from publication. Replaced inherited child environment with minimal task environment and filtered harness environment dumps.

Chromium suite completed, collector expected the wrong Raptor report location. Original output salvaged under resource lock. Fixed collector to move actual mozharness shared upload/report outputs after every invocation.

Chromium collector passed. Official Firefox failed privileged trusted-script access, including harness retries. Added Firefox159-required MOZ_REMOTE_ALLOW_SYSTEM_ACCESS=1 only for isolated harness children; no OOM event found.
Single official Firefox validation suite passed; diagnostic subset, excluded from comparison.
Single source Firefox validation suite passed; diagnostic subset, excluded from comparison.

summary_repair: Original summary encountered the saved harness/ directory as if it were a browser run. Reproduced failure, narrowly skipped harness/, reran complete cohort summary. Executed runner snapshot and all scored results unchanged; snapshot retains original summary script. test_summary.py covers the actual directory-layout regression and contamination rejection.
build_wrapper_repair: Native mach completed successfully; running wrapper had been edited and Bash reported EOF after mach returned. Wrapper exit2 retained. Final exec-based wrapper tested in isolated fake-mach harness (exit0/7); preserved package and source smoke both pass.
preservation_guard_repair: Final publication review found that a strict HEAD==release-tag guard would reject the committed baseline tooling. Final preservation checks source equivalence outside tools/performance/baseline, records both release source and actual checkout revisions, and was tested in an isolated Git/package fixture: accepts baseline tooling commit, verifies hashes, rejects engine mutation before packaging. Existing sealed stock runtime was created with HEAD exactly at the tag; it remains unchanged.
